rationale: The Court is likely to issue a narrow AEDPA/Strickland reversal emphasizing Richter/Visciotti “doubly deferential” review and rejecting the Ninth Circuit’s de novo reweighing, while avoiding broad Eddings pronouncements. A Sotomayor dissent is likely to focus on causal-nexus discounting of mitigation as structurally incompatible with meaningful prejudice review.
